offlineBackdropBake.note: Existing high-detail soccer-v4 models were used only for the offline 1024px raster backdrop. The resulting WebP is the sole scene resource at runtime. These source models are not claimed to meet the v6 player LOD budgets.

svgTessellation: Browser-managed rasterization; no three.js geometry or WebGL draw calls are added.
